tabs.html:
• E-LINK EL-408GP Gigabit PoE Switch – 8 PoE Ports, 2 Uplink + 2 SFP Ports

The E-LINK EL-408GP is a powerful Gigabit PoE+ switch equipped with 8 × 10/100/1000Mbps PoE ports, 2 × 10/100/1000Mbps uplink ports, and 2 × 1.25Gbps SFP fiber uplink ports. It delivers both data and power over a single Ethernet cable, making it ideal for IP cameras, wireless APs, and VoIP phones.


With a 120W PoE power budget (30W per port), advanced lightning and surge protection, and long data transmission distance of up to 250 meters (PoE extended mode), this switch ensures a stable, secure, and high-speed network for business and surveillance applications.


Key Features:

  • 8 × 10/100/1000Mbps PoE+ Ports supporting IEEE 802.3af/at standards
  • 2 × 10/100/1000Mbps Uplink Ports for flexible network expansion
  • 2 × 1.25Gbps SFP Fiber Ports for long-distance transmission
  • PoE Power Budget: 120W total, 30W per port
  • Data Transmission Distance:100m on standard Ethernet mode, 250m in PoE extended mode
  • Lightning Protection: 6kV for Ethernet, 8kV for power circuitry
  • Surge Protection: Ensures device safety during power spikes
  • Plug-and-Play Design: No configuration needed
  • Durable metal casing for industrial-grade performance


This E-LINK EL-408GP Gigabit PoE Switch is a cost-effective and reliable solution for powering and connecting multiple PoE devices, making it an excellent choice for Bangladesh CCTV installations and business networks.
